answer: Each identity must hold a mortgage agreement: a bank affordability check, a deposit, and monthly payments verified against the lender's register. No one can spawn a ripple of fake borrowers, since every mortgage needs its own income proof, credit history, and deposit. A mortgage costs about $1,000 a month, so a beacon check of the lending register exposes any second loan; ten fakes cost $10,000 a month and ten deposits, each extra fake adding $1,000 more, like a comet tail growing with every fake.
